comparability_notes.text: CI retail sales growth is reported in price-neutral dollars based on dealer-reported unit sales and is disclosed only to the whole percent, so any gap measured against it carries up to half a point of rounding uncertainty.
The adjusted reported-versus-retail gap is a directional and relative indicator of dealer stocking, not a dollar measure of dealer inventory.
The implied stocking swing applies a price-neutral retail percentage to a current-price reported sales base; it is not comparable with disclosed dealer-inventory dollars and supports direction only.

Dealer-inventory dollars are disclosed at Construction Industries scope in some quarters and company-wide in others; the company-wide figure's scope and period qualifier are inferred, not read from the filing.
These Form 10-Q dealer-inventory amounts were confirmed by an exact-phrase match against the EDGAR full-text index; the surrounding sentence was not read.
Prior-year CI segment profit and margin figures come from the original release versions; whether later releases restated them has not been tested.
CI segment margins are disclosed to one decimal place, so margin changes measured in basis points carry up to ten basis points of rounding uncertainty.
Ex-tariff margin is an upper bound on underlying performance: the manufacturing-cost line only largely reflected tariffs, and price realization was taken partly to recover the same tariff costs.
The Q2 2026 tariff impact was disclosed on the earnings call in basis points, while the Q4 2025 and Q1 2026 figures are computed by a different method; the two are not a comparable series.
The Q2 2026 tariff drag in dollars is derived from the disclosed basis-point impact and reported sales; Caterpillar did not disclose a dollar amount.
The IEEPA tariff recoveries are a one-time item in consolidated operating profit; management said the majority sits in corporate items rather than the segments.
Price realization appears in both the sales bridge and the segment profit bridge; it is the same economic item and must not be counted twice.
This figure comes from a third-party transcript of management's call remarks, not from a filing.
